title: Borromean Triads, the Ring Lemma, and Spectral Non-Dispersal
keywords: Navier-Stokes, turbulence, vorticity, spectral methods, PDE, harmonic analysis
desc:
This preprint introduces a conditional regularity framework for the 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes equations based on spectral localization and geometric control of vorticity direction.

Key contributions include:
- The Ring Lemma, bounding vorticity direction gradients by shell frequency
- A Spectral Non-Dispersal (SND) condition
- A Global Summation Lemma under SND
- Global regularity of an augmented Navier–Stokes system with targeted operators

No claim
